activity_summary: At the Theatre you set Titus at two, and yourself done in the fourth act, an old Roman and not a long one. Thomas does not wait on the death and does not take up a failed word. The eleven lines stay at the lodging. Thomas had read the Rose bill, Seven Days and Wise Man, on a post, and had not gone nearer. You did not go either.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the hour, the fourth act, and the old Roman, and left Verona at home.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Set one play, and said the Rose bill was their afternoon.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Kept the roll, and refused Verona in the Roman plot.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Asked where his cue sits, and reported the bill he had read on a post.
